objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, revised, archived, reactivated, and translated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document type abbreviation included in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive number included in the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version information printed as metadata and managed during revision.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata printable in the document.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Area of validity maintained in document properties.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used to define templates, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which validity extension is checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating a new document.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created by release, revision, validity extension, override, or reactivation handling.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment released with the main document and subject to versioning and archiving.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle and published directly through properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document and managed without directly affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person participating as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, applicant, or initiator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned authorizations, distribution, archive access, or administration rights.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is nearing expiry.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate and archive a released document.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to re-validate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for a document containing persons or user groups for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from distribution recipients for a released document version.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for a released version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system where document visibility can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document object in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type or template.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and document control properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit the document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations to a document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add additional information to a document.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly through switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled attachment to a document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark or archive an attachment associated with a document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Start the three-step release process for a document.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation step of the workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the document in the review step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves the document and the document is released.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Workflow participant rejects the document during review or release.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the released document so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Create a new editing version of a released document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned change proposals.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension before document validity expires.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of a validity extension request.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the document valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Create a request for override for a selected document.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of an override request.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare a document out of force and archive it.

evts.name: delete_archived_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: process_reactivation_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of a reactivation request by the initiator.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document and reactivate its attachments.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons to document distribution by e-mail or acknowledgement.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request recipients to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the document version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Check and release the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible.

o2o.description: Document is classified by a selected document type.
One or more templates can be defined for each document type.
Attachment belongs to a document and is released or archived with it.
Additional info is added to a document.
Change proposal belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
Validity extension request is linked to the document to be checked.
Override request is created for a selected document.
Reactivation request selects the corresponding document.
Distribution list is maintained for each document.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Acknowledgement confirms receipt of a document version.
Signatures are documented for each released version.
Users are assigned to user groups.
Users can be assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, applicant, or initiator.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reading, authorizations, archive access, or distribution.
Document visibility can be specified per client.

Template can be selected when creating the document.
Saved document is converted to PDF.
Authorizations are assigned for the document.
Additional info is added to the document.
Additional info is created or attached.

Additional info is released and published.
Attachment is added to the document.
Author decides to add an attachment.
Archiving attachment affects the associated document version.
Release workflow is started for the document.
Author or co-author starts the workflow.
Reviewer completes the task with an electronic signature.
Attachments are automatically released with the main document.
Releaser completes the task with an electronic signature.
Employee with author rights creates the proposal.
Proposal is created for the document.
Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new version of the document.
Document approaching expiry triggers the request.
Request is processed with workflow support.
Releaser, author, co-author, or reviewer participates according to the process.
Document remains valid and valid-until date is updated.
Request is deleted after additional validity is declared.
Attachments are also released and have the same validity as the main document.
Request is created for a selected document.
User with write access creates the request.
Override request is processed in workflow.
Releaser, applicant, reviewer, or releaser participates according to the process.
Document is declared out of force and archived.
Attachments are declared invalid and archived with the document.
Override request is retained for documentation.
Archive group retains read access while other rights are revoked.
Archived document is physically deleted after archive duration.

Business Admin group is permitted to create the request.
New version is created upon reactivation.

Distribution list is maintained for the document.
Users are informed when a new document version is released.
Users of assigned groups receive e-mail notification.
Acknowledgement is requested upon release of the version.
Translated version is checked and released.
Participants check and release the translation.
Clients where the document is visible are specified.
